PricingFaq.heading: Frequently Asked Questions

PricingFaq.q2: What happens when the trial ends?
PricingFaq.a2: Once the trial ends, you can choose a plan that matches your team size and needs. You won't be charged automatically.
PricingFaq.q3: Can my team use CraftWise on-site?

PricingFaq.q4: Can I change my plan later?

FeaturesFaq.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
FeaturesFaq.q1: Can CraftWise grow with my business?
FeaturesFaq.a1: Yes. CraftWise is built for small teams but scales easily. You can add more users, projects, and features as your company expands.
FeaturesFaq.q2: Is training required for my team?
FeaturesFaq.a2: No. CraftWise is designed to be intuitive and user-friendly, so most teams can start using it right away with minimal training.
FeaturesFaq.q3: Can CraftWise integrate with other tools I use?
FeaturesFaq.a3: Yes. CraftWise offers integrations and exports for tools like calendar apps and accounting software (DATEV, lexoffice, sevdesk).
FeaturesFaq.q4: What makes CraftWise different from competitors?
FeaturesFaq.a4: CraftWise is specifically built for trade businesses: clear, practical, and designed for both office and job site. Fewer clicks, more clarity — and real support when you need it.
FeaturesFaq.q5: Can I import existing data into CraftWise?
FeaturesFaq.a5: Yes. You can import data from Excel/CSV, making it easy to transition quickly and cleanly.
FeaturesFaq.q6: What's the difference between an Office and an On-Site license?
FeaturesFaq.a6: Office is for desk-based work (planning, documents, organization). On-Site is for field crews (tasks, time, photos, updates). Both access the same system — optimized per role.
FeaturesFaq.q7: Can I export invoices and data to DATEV, lexoffice, or sevdesk?

gettingStarted.q1: How quickly can I get started with CraftWise?
gettingStarted.a1: You can get started right away. Once you begin your free trial, CraftWise guides you through a simple setup so your account is ready to use in minutes.
gettingStarted.q2: Can I try CraftWise for free?
gettingStarted.a2: Yes. You can test CraftWise free for 14 days and explore all core features before making a decision.
gettingStarted.q3: Do I need a credit card to start the trial?
gettingStarted.a3: No. You can start your trial without entering payment details.
gettingStarted.q4: What's included in the free trial?
gettingStarted.a4: The free trial includes access to all major CraftWise features, including quoting, invoicing, scheduling, tasks, projects, time tracking, and mobile use.
gettingStarted.q5: Can I book a demo before signing up?
gettingStarted.a5: Yes. You can book a free demo if you want to see how CraftWise fits your workflows before starting a trial.
gettingStarted.q6: Is CraftWise easy to set up?
gettingStarted.a6: Yes. CraftWise is designed to be simple and practical, so most businesses can get started without a complicated implementation process.
gettingStarted.q7: Can I invite my team during setup?
gettingStarted.a7: Yes. You can invite team members directly in the setup process or while testing from the company settings and start working together quickly.

usingCraftwise.a1: Yes. CraftWise is available on web and mobile (iOS & Android) so your team can access tasks, schedules, files, and updates from anywhere.
usingCraftwise.q2: Can my team use CraftWise on site?
usingCraftwise.a2: Yes. CraftWise is built for field use as well as office work, so your team can update information directly from the job site.
usingCraftwise.q3: Can I upload my own documents and drawings?
usingCraftwise.a3: Yes. You can upload plans, contracts, blueprints, photos, and other project files into your project workspace.
usingCraftwise.q4: Can I work on multiple projects at once?
usingCraftwise.a4: Yes. CraftWise helps you manage multiple active jobs at the same time while keeping tasks, files, schedules, and updates organized.
usingCraftwise.q5: Can office staff and field crews work in the same system?
usingCraftwise.a5: Yes. CraftWise is designed to connect the office and the job site in one shared workspace.
usingCraftwise.q6: Can team members update tasks and notes directly?
usingCraftwise.a6: Yes. Users can update tasks, upload files, add notes, and log hours directly from the app.
usingCraftwise.a7: Yes. By combining your core workflows in one system, CraftWise helps reduce manual admin and paper-based processes.

isCraftwiseRightForMe.a1: CraftWise is built specifically for trade businesses such as electricians, plumbers, roofers, painters, carpenters, landscapers, and similar hands-on teams.
isCraftwiseRightForMe.q2: What size of company is CraftWise best for?
isCraftwiseRightForMe.a2: CraftWise works for solo tradespeople, small teams, and growing businesses with up to around 50 employees.
isCraftwiseRightForMe.q3: Is CraftWise suitable for new businesses?
isCraftwiseRightForMe.a3: Yes. CraftWise is a strong fit for new businesses because it helps create structure from the start.
isCraftwiseRightForMe.q4: Does CraftWise also work for growing companies?
isCraftwiseRightForMe.a4: Yes. You can start with a small setup and expand as your team, projects, and workflows grow.
isCraftwiseRightForMe.q5: Is CraftWise useful for companies with many small jobs?
isCraftwiseRightForMe.a5: Yes. It works well for businesses handling recurring work, service jobs, and multiple smaller projects alongside larger ones.
isCraftwiseRightForMe.q6: Is CraftWise only for office teams?
isCraftwiseRightForMe.a6: No. It is designed for both office staff and field teams, so everyone can work from the same information.
isCraftwiseRightForMe.q7: How does CraftWise improve daily work?
isCraftwiseRightForMe.a7: CraftWise reduces admin effort, improves clarity, and helps teams stay aligned across projects, schedules, documents, and communication.

features.q1: What features are included in CraftWise?
features.a1: CraftWise includes quoting, invoicing, task management, planning and scheduling, time tracking, project and file management, and team communication.
features.q2: Can I create quotes and invoices in CraftWise?
features.a2: Yes. You can create professional documents quickly and keep them connected to the right project and workflow.
features.q3: Can I customize documents like quotes and invoices?
features.a3: Yes. You can add your branding, use templates, and create documents that match your business.
features.q4: Does CraftWise include planning and scheduling tools?
features.a4: Yes. CraftWise includes planning boards, scheduling views, and appointment tools to help you organise jobs and teams.
features.q5: Can I manage files and documents inside projects?
features.a5: Yes. Each project acts as a central workspace for documents, plans, photos, and updates.
features.q6: Can my team upload photos and files from mobile?
features.a6: Yes. Files, notes, and photos can be uploaded directly from mobile devices and synced to the office.
features.q7: Can I manage tasks inside projects?
features.a7: Yes. Tasks can be created, assigned, and tracked directly within the relevant project context.
features.q8: Can I track time and job-related work?
features.a8: Yes. CraftWise helps you log and review hours so you have a better overview of work completed and project progress.

accountBilling.q1: What happens after my free trial ends?
accountBilling.a1: When your trial ends, you can choose a paid plan that fits your business. Your data remains available, and your account can continue without interruption.
accountBilling.a2: Yes. You can cancel your subscription at any time. You can use CraftWise until your license expires if not renewed.
accountBilling.q3: Can I change my plan later?
accountBilling.a3: Yes. You can adjust your plan, user count, or license mix as your team changes.
accountBilling.q4: What payment options do you accept?
accountBilling.a4: CraftWise supports secure online payment methods, including major cards and common digital payment options.
accountBilling.q5: Is there a discount for annual plans?
accountBilling.a5: Yes. Annual billing is available at a lower rate than monthly billing.
accountBilling.a6: Yes. Pricing is based on the number and type of user-licenses you need.
accountBilling.q7: What happens if I cancel my subscription?
accountBilling.a7: Your account stays active until the end of the billing period. Your data remains safe and can be exported.

technicalIssues.a1: You can reach our support team by email or through the in-app help options.
technicalIssues.a2: Yes. Live chat is available directly in the application during business hours.
technicalIssues.q3: Is support included in my subscription?
technicalIssues.a3: Yes. Standard support is included in all CraftWise plans.
technicalIssues.q4: Do you charge extra for support?
technicalIssues.a4: No. Standard support and help resources are included. Additional consulting services are optionally available.
technicalIssues.q5: What languages does your support team cover?
technicalIssues.a5: Our support team currently supports English and German.
technicalIssues.q6: Is there a help center or knowledge base?
technicalIssues.a6: Yes. CraftWise includes support resources and guidance to help your team solve common questions quickly.
technicalIssues.a7: We aim to respond quickly during business hours and provide practical, useful help for day-to-day questions.

consultingTraining.q1: Do you offer training for my team?
consultingTraining.a1: Yes. We offer training for office staff, managers, and field teams.
consultingTraining.q2: Can you train teams online or on-site?
consultingTraining.a2: Yes. Depending on your needs, training can be provided online (standard) or through tailored on-site sessions.
consultingTraining.q3: What kind of consulting do you provide?
consultingTraining.a3: We support process optimization, app setup, onboarding, workflow design, and broader digital transformation in trade businesses. Consulting packages and individual options are available, depending on the demand.
consultingTraining.q4: Is training included in my subscription?
consultingTraining.a4: Basic guidance is included (20 min onboarding call and limited support). More in-depth workshops and consulting services are available as add-ons.
consultingTraining.q5: How long does onboarding usually take?
consultingTraining.a5: Many teams are ready within a few days. Larger businesses may need more time depending on their processes and team size.
consultingTraining.q6: Can you help us improve our internal workflows?
consultingTraining.a6: Yes. We can help identify bottlenecks, simplify processes, and improve how your team works with CraftWise.
consultingTraining.q7: Do you support team adoption during rollout?
consultingTraining.a7: Yes. We help make sure both office staff and on-site teams feel confident using the platform from day one.

pricePlan.q1: Do you offer monthly and annual billing?
pricePlan.a1: Yes. You can choose between flexible monthly billing and discounted annual billing.
pricePlan.q2: Can I mix different license types?
pricePlan.a2: Yes. Many businesses use a mix of office-focused and on-site-focused licenses. Four different license types are available, while at least one Owner License needs to remain at any point of time.
pricePlan.q3: Do I only pay for the users I need?
pricePlan.a3: Yes. You choose the amount of licenses you purchase. License amounts and mixture are up to you.
pricePlan.q4: Can I start small and expand later?
pricePlan.a4: Absolutely. Many businesses begin with a small setup and add users as they grow.
pricePlan.q5: Does CraftWise scale with my team size?
pricePlan.a5: Yes. CraftWise is designed to grow with your business over time.
pricePlan.q6: Are software updates included in my plan?
pricePlan.a6: Yes. Regular software updates and improvements are included in your subscription.
pricePlan.q7: Is onboarding or consulting included in the price?
pricePlan.a7: Basic support and setup guidance are included. Additional onboarding and consulting services can be booked separately.
pricePlan.q8: Is CraftWise a good fit for long-term growth?
pricePlan.a8: Yes. CraftWise is designed to support businesses as they grow in team size, project complexity, and operational structure.

PlanningScheduling.rudwStep4Text: Out on the site, workers check schedules on their phones. Updates are always clear and simple. No more waiting for calls or chasing missing details.
PlanningScheduling.testimonial1Text: The planning board gives the whole crew clarity from the start of the day. That saves us a lot of calls.
PlanningScheduling.testimonial2Text: We used to lose time with messy plans and double bookings. Now the schedule is finally clear for everyone.
PlanningScheduling.testimonial3Text: When weather changes a job, we can reschedule in minutes and the team sees it right away on site.
PlanningScheduling.testimonial4Text: Appointments, crews, and deadlines are much easier to manage when everything sits on one shared board.
PlanningScheduling.testimonial5Text: I can adjust plans quickly without creating confusion. Everyone sees the latest schedule and keeps moving.

PlanningScheduling.faq6Question: Can supervisors update schedules while on site?

ProjectFile.heroTitle: Keep Every File in One Place
ProjectFile.heroDescription: Store every project file in a secure cloud space. Need a document on site? It's already on your phone. Want to share project updates with your crew? One click and they have it. Staying organized has never been this simple.
ProjectFile.rudwSubtitle: File management should feel natural. Here is how teams use it each day.
ProjectFile.rudwStep1Text: The supervisor opens today's project. Plans, safety sheets, and checklists are ready. Everyone sees the same documents. Work starts without delays.
ProjectFile.rudwStep2Text: A technician snaps photos of the install. Images are uploaded from the phone with a short note. The office gets context and can approve the next step.
ProjectFile.rudwStep3Text: A new drawing arrives from the engineer. It's uploaded to the project, the old version is archived automatically, and the team sees the update instantly.
ProjectFile.rudwStep4Text: At the end of the job, all files sit in the project folder. Reports, photos, and handover docs are complete and easy to find.
ProjectFile.bfDescription: Managing files should not feel like a puzzle. With CraftWise, everything has its place and is simple to handle.
ProjectFile.bfCard1Text: All your project documents live in one space. Plans, photos, reports, and permits are stored together so the full story is always clear.
ProjectFile.bfCard2Text: You find files in seconds. Search by name, project, or tag. Recent uploads show up right away, so teams waste no time digging through folders.
ProjectFile.bfCard3Text: Forget the stress of working with outdated drawings. Replace a file, keep the history, and mark the latest version. Everyone knows which file is current.
ProjectFile.bfCard4Text: Send a document link or share files inside the job. Control who can view or download. Clients and partners get exactly what they need without confusion.
ProjectFile.bfCard5Text: Photos and notes are uploaded directly from phones. Supervisors and office staff see updates instantly and can act fast. Work keeps flowing.

ProjectFile.testimonial1Text: Everything for the job finally sits in one place. Files, photos, and updates are easy for the whole team to find.
ProjectFile.testimonial2Text: We used to waste too much time searching for plans and attachments. Now every project is much easier to manage.
ProjectFile.testimonial3Text: The shared project folder is a huge help. Office and site always work with the same documents and the latest version.

WorkflowsAutomation.rudwSubtitle: Automation is not about replacing your work. It is about making your daily routine smoother and less stressful.
WorkflowsAutomation.rudwStep1Text: Instead of typing every line, CraftWise suggests items and prices from documents and the service catalogue you use often. Quotes are ready in minutes and always look professional.
WorkflowsAutomation.rudwStep2Text: A project gets delayed. You move the date once, and all linked items update instantly. The office and the crew see the change right away.
WorkflowsAutomation.rudwStep3Text: An invoice is overdue. The system notifies you so you can follow up. Tasks also get alerts, keeping projects on track without chasing people.
WorkflowsAutomation.rudwStep4Text: Upload once and share with the right project automatically. Everyone works with the latest version without confusion.
WorkflowsAutomation.bfDescription: Running a trade business often means dealing with repetitive tasks that take up too much time. CraftWise Automation cuts through the noise and handles the busywork for you.
WorkflowsAutomation.bfCard1Text: Hours disappear into building quotes, updating schedules, or sending reminders. Automation takes care of these steps so you and your team can focus on real work.
WorkflowsAutomation.bfCard2Text: Manual admin leads to costly errors and delays. With automated updates and calculations, your documents stay accurate and your projects run smoothly.
WorkflowsAutomation.bfCard3Text: Quickly reuse stored positions, prices, and materials from previous projects or templates. Build consistent quotes and tasks faster, without retyping or copy-pasting.
WorkflowsAutomation.bfCard4Text: Change one detail and the system updates the rest. A new project date automatically adjusts schedules and planning boards. Everyone sees the change instantly.
WorkflowsAutomation.bfCard5Text: CraftWise sends automatic reminders for key activities — invoices, approvals, tasks, file uploads, and schedule changes — so projects stay on time and nothing gets forgotten.
WorkflowsAutomation.testimonial1Text: When one step is done, the next one is already prepared. That saves us a lot of admin every week.
WorkflowsAutomation.testimonial2Text: Status changes, reminders, and updates finally run in a clear system instead of getting lost in daily chaos.
WorkflowsAutomation.testimonial3Text: We spend less time chasing follow-ups because CraftWise keeps the important next steps visible.
WorkflowsAutomation.testimonial4Text: What I like most is that schedules, documents, and tasks stay connected when something changes.
WorkflowsAutomation.testimonial5Text: Reminders and workflow logic take pressure off the team and help us stay on top of busy projects.
WorkflowsAutomation.testimonial6Text: CraftWise makes the workday feel more structured because routine steps no longer depend on memory alone.
WorkflowsAutomation.faq1Question: What does CraftWise Automation actually do?
WorkflowsAutomation.faq1Answer: Recurring admin runs automatically in the background — such as building quotes, updating schedules, or sending reminders. That leaves more time for real jobs.
WorkflowsAutomation.faq2Answer: For example: steps from quote to invoice, status and task updates, notifications for schedule changes, and recurring reminders.
WorkflowsAutomation.faq3Answer: No. Automation supports your team but does not replace it. You stay in control and can review or adjust everything.
WorkflowsAutomation.faq4Question: Can the system learn from past projects?
WorkflowsAutomation.faq4Answer: Yes. CraftWise can reuse recurring items, templates, and typical workflows so new work runs faster and more consistently.
WorkflowsAutomation.faq5Question: Does it help with plan changes too?
WorkflowsAutomation.faq5Answer: Yes. When something changes, the right people can be notified automatically and connected tasks updated right away.
WorkflowsAutomation.faq6Question: How do reminders and follow-ups work?
WorkflowsAutomation.faq6Answer: CraftWise can automatically remind you about open tasks, approvals, deadlines, or unpaid invoices — so nothing gets missed.
WorkflowsAutomation.faq7Question: Is data secure when everything runs automatically?
WorkflowsAutomation.faq7Answer: Yes. Automations follow the same access rights and security rules as the rest of CraftWise. Only authorised users can see or trigger actions.
WorkflowsAutomation.ctaTitle: Ready to let Automation do the Heavy Lifting?
